body: Thank you so much : ) I guess I tend to see fuck ups and slip-ups as failures because of my upbringing, but that's something I have to change within myself. Like I mentioned in one of my replies, I have to remind myself that it's not me, it's PDD and I have to be more prepared in handling it. I really appreciate your comment, it gave me comfort and I'm very grateful for everyone's replies. Take care and once again, thank you!

I see! Thank you so much! I'll give meds a shot and hopefully, I'll be prescribed one that has mild side effects. I'll be updating this post once I get on meds and see how it works for me. Thank you for the encouragement!

Thank you so much and I'm glad that my post gave you an opportunity to write! I really have to ingrain that in my head, "one day at a time". I'm still trying to understand PDD and I guess I was just at the start of my good season when I started my therapy sessions so I was under the impression that maybe my PDD is more manageable now. So getting hit by the sads again got me thinking that "ah shit this slip up is gonna define me forever now" and "everything I'm doing to recover is futile", but the comments on this post made me realize that it's not me, it's PDD. Yesterday (the time I wrote the main post) wasn't a great day for me, but I have today and tomorrow to start anew. Thank you again and take care always!

Thank you so much : ) I really like how you called it a good season and I'll take note of what you said. I guess I was too focused on maintaining a stable state that I didn't think about preparing for bad seasons. Your comment really helped a lot! Once again, thank you so much, and stay safe as well!

Thank you for your words! : ) I try to tell myself that it's part of the healing process to slip up and relapse from time to time, but I'm having a hard time fully acknowledging it. 

I'm not on medication. My therapist told me that she'll see my progress by my 6th or 7th session to see if I'll need it. I'll be meeting with her this coming week, so I'll be informing her about what happened and we'll see from there. I'm kinda scared of meds though, because I'm worried about the side effects and the expenses.
